deployments_idempotency_pair_check.name: deployments_idempotency_pair_check
deployments_idempotency_pair_check.value: ("deployments"."idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "deployments"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("deployments"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "deployments"."request_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("deployments"."idempotency_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND "deployments"."request_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

environment_variables_scope_owner_check.name: environment_variables_scope_owner_check
environment_variables_scope_owner_check.value: ("environment_variables"."scope" = 'project' AND "environment_variables"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "environment_variables"."service_id" IS NULL) OR ("environment_variables"."scope" = 'environment' AND "environment_variables"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "environment_variables"."service_id" IS NULL) OR ("environment_variables"."scope" = 'service' AND "environment_variables"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "environment_variables"."environment_id" IS NULL)

servers_proxy_acme_email_check.name: servers_proxy_acme_email_check
servers_proxy_acme_email_check.value: "proxy_acme_email" IS NULL OR char_length("proxy_acme_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254

services_source_shape_check.name: services_source_shape_check
services_source_shape_check.value: ("services"."source_type" = 'git' AND "services"."repository_url" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."branch" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."build_context" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."dockerfile_path" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."image_ref" IS NULL) OR ("services"."source_type" = 'image' AND "services"."image_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."repository_url" IS NULL AND "services"."branch" IS NULL AND "services"."build_context" IS NULL AND "services"."dockerfile_path" IS NULL AND "services"."build_target" IS NULL)

services_webhook_pair_check.name: services_webhook_pair_check
services_webhook_pair_check.value: "services"."webhook_secret_credential_id" IS NULL OR "services"."webhook_hook_id" IS NOT NULL

services_pending_trigger_check.name: services_pending_trigger_check
services_pending_trigger_check.value: ("services"."pending_trigger_delivery_id" IS NULL AND "services"."pending_trigger_sha" IS NULL AND "services"."pending_trigger_at" IS NULL) OR ("services"."pending_trigger_delivery_id" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."pending_trigger_at" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."pending_trigger_sha" IS NOT NULL AND "services"."pending_trigger_sha" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')

services_ports_range_check.name: services_ports_range_check
services_ports_range_check.value: "services"."internal_port" BETWEEN 1 AND 65535 AND ("services"."published_port" IS NULL OR "services"."published_port" BETWEEN 1 AND 65535)

webhook_deliveries_delivery_id_check.name: webhook_deliveries_delivery_id_check
webhook_deliveries_delivery_id_check.value: char_length("webhook_deliveries"."delivery_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND char_length("webhook_deliveries"."event") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

secrets_scope_owner_check.name: secrets_scope_owner_check
secrets_scope_owner_check.value: ("secrets"."scope" = 'project' AND "secrets"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "secrets"."service_id" IS NULL) OR ("secrets"."scope" = 'environment' AND "secrets"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secrets"."service_id" IS NULL) OR ("secrets"."scope" = 'service' AND "secrets"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "secrets"."environment_id" IS NULL)
